What role do product design decisions play in determining the overall environmental impact of a garment throughout its lifecycle?

Design choices affect impacts from fiber production through disposal: material type, fabric efficiency, durability, repairability, care needs, and ease of recycling all matter. Longer-lasting, repairable designs may reduce replacement demand, while complex blends or finishes can hinder recycling. Lifecycle assessment can compare trade-offs, but real-world benefits depend on how garments are made, used, and ultimately handled.
